comment: The Recorder counts frames as taken and says when the video is done. Shift+X opens the Recorder (Shift+R is Repeat Last), Record starts a recording and the line says a frame comes two seconds after each change. A stroke, a look half a second after it with no frame yet, and a look after the settle with one frame of a few dozen KB. Stop, Make Video, and after several seconds the line says Video done with the absolute path of the file ffmpeg wrote, the docker drawn wider for the last shot so the path reads whole. Run with a PATH whose ffmpeg exits without writing, the last line says ffmpeg did not make the video and names the folder its frames are in. Run with no ffmpeg on the PATH, Make Video is greyed and the pointer resting on it shows the tooltip saying ffmpeg was not found.
